thread:
Aisha (Support): FYI customer PROD account is seeing 429s on our dedicated cluster during short bursts. They report sustained qps ~120 for ~30s, then a wave of 429s. They have a reserved pool. Can someone sanity-check the quota/handshake?
Devon (Eng-runtime): Thanks. Which reserved pool? any pool_id or tenant id?
Aisha (Support): pool id rp-58fc, tenant acme-corp-42. Customer says SLA is 100 qps but they can spike to 150 briefly.
Paulo (SRE): Quick check — that sounds like token-bucket burst exhaustion. Can you paste a sample response headers when they get 429?
Aisha (Support): Got this from their repro: 

HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Date: Tue, 03 May 2026 14:02:03 GMT
Content-Type: application/json
X-RateLimit-Limit: 100
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 30
X-Reserved-Pool-ID: rp-58fc

{"error":"rate_limited","detail":"reserved pool capacity exceeded"}

Devon (Eng-runtime): That header set is helpful. Looks like the cluster is enforcing the per-tenant limit (100). But reserved pools normally allow short bursts depending on cushion. We should check reserved pool config: burst_cushion, refill_rate, and max_burst_tokens.
Nora (Billing): Also confirm there's no billing-based suspension or metering mismatch. If billing shows usage over committed cap we might gate.
Paulo (SRE): Running quick query against telemetry for rp-58fc: spike at 14:01:55 -> peak 156 qps, sustained ~28s, then drop. Refill interval is 1s and tokens per second aligned to 100. max_burst_tokens currently 0.
Aisha (Support): max_burst_tokens = 0? I thought reserved pools had some burst headroom. Customer expectation came from SLA doc that says "short bursts up to 150 qps tolerated".
Devon (Eng-runtime): SLA language can be ambiguous. For this pool the operator set max_burst_tokens=0 to guarantee steady throughput for others. Essentially no burst headroom. That's why they see 429s immediately once they exceed steady qps.
Paulo (SRE): Repro steps for engineering to validate: 1) run load with steady 100 qps + 40 qps spike for 30s against rp-58fc 2) capture headers and token bucket metrics from /internal/metrics?tenant=acme-corp-42 3) confirm x_reserved_pool_* counters.
Devon (Eng-runtime): I'll reproduce in staging with same pool config. If customer needs bursts we can propose two options: a) increase max_burst_tokens to allow short cushion (affects neighbor isolation), b) route bursts to on-demand fallback (hosted) automatically. Need product signoff.
Nora (Billing): If we increase burst tokens, we should ensure billing reflects potential overage. I'll flag account as "burst-eligible pending opt-in" and generate estimate for 30s/150 qps profile.
Aisha (Support): Customer asked for steps they can take now to reduce 429s — is there a client-side recommendation?
Devon (Eng-runtime): Recommend exponential backoff + smooth windowing. For streamed responses, keep concurrency lower and smooth the spike across a 5s ramp. Example curl-based load: 

for i in {1..150}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"x"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate & sleep 0.03; done

That spreads it out. Also they can use the retry-after header to backoff.
Paulo (SRE): I've flagged an incident ticket INC-2026-789 for visibility. tagging eng-runtime. deploy-bot: created incident INC-2026-789 and paged on-call.
deploy-bot: Incident INC-2026-789 created by Paulo. Severity: S2. Pager routed to Eng-runtime.
Devon (Eng-runtime): Repro in staging shows identical 429 behavior with current config. Will open PR to expose pool burst settings in console and add a per-pool cushion default of 50 tokens (configurable).
Aisha (Support): Great. I've updated customer with: we can enable short bursts via config change or set up hosted fallback. They want the fast path; asked for ETA.
Devon (Eng-runtime): ETA for console change + opt-in workflow ~3 business days. For immediate fix we can enable max_burst_tokens=50 on their pool manually after billing signoff.
Nora (Billing): I approved manual opt-in for acme-corp-42 pending PO confirmation. Aisha, please collect PO and I'll apply the change.
Aisha (Support): Will do. Closing loop in thread once we flip burst_tokens. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
